name: POST /api/dialer/campaigns - Create an outbound AI-call campaign
description: Creates a DRAFT campaign (95b9060e-9695-45f9-a970-323d68d6a444#AC1 — a tenant can create a campaign, upload contacts in batches and pause, resume or cancel it). Body: agent_id (the tenant's voice agent; it must be outbound/both and published only when the campaign STARTS), name (unique per tenant, 1-120), optional marketing_campaign_id (soft link to an sdk-campaign marketing campaign), default_timezone (IANA, default UTC — used for contacts without their own), window_start/window_end (HH:MM recipient-local calling window, default 08:00-21:00), max_concurrency (1-1000, default 5), max_attempts (1-10, default 3), retry_spacing_minutes (1-10 values of 1-10080, default [60,240,1440]), voicemail_policy (hang_up | drop_tts | drop_recording; drop_* needs voicemail_message), caller_id_pool (up to 100 E.164 numbers), context (JSON object <= 32 KB).
